thesis: The conversation argues that Numerai has evolved from a small experiment into a large-scale institutional market neutral hedge fund by shifting from a leaderboard-driven model to a capital-weighted signal engine using the NMR token. This structural change aligns incentives by forcing researchers to stake real capital, thereby rewarding conviction and accountability while naturally filtering out noise and discouraging system gaming behaviors.
